class.name: drag_teleop_controller/DragTeleopController
class.description: Drag teleop controller. Builds a Pinocchio model from the URDF (robot_description parameter) and writes static gravity torques (RNEA with zero velocity/acceleration) to the effort command interfaces of the hardware interface. Joints are kept at their current positions; optional soft kp/kd command interfaces can be written for a low-stiffness hold. Gripper joints can be listed in hold_joints to keep them in place (position follow).
